QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired too. The same vector means three different things.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the tokenizer wrapper returns `{}` on failed tokenization and that the backend's `tokenize` returns the same `{}` when no tokenizer is wired, so callers can't tell the two apart.
